# git: alias: add contribute command

Add `git contribute`, a commit whose date is chosen by the `maintainer` tool rather than typed as an offset. **Motivation:** [octomation/maintainer#56](https://github.com/octomation/maintainer/issues/56) implemented `github contribution suggest`, which picks a day in the past where an extra contribution evens out the GitHub calendar; combining it with `git at` ([[DOT-77]]) removes the manual step:

```bash
$ git contribute 2021 some commit message
```
